answer: Consumable sample fingerprint registry. Activation requires a tamper-evident physical sample, chain-of-custody, and measured profile; the registry hashes it, rejects duplicates, and marks the aliquot consumed. A karst water vial yields one accepted answer tied to that collected aliquot. A garden soil core binds one identity to one destroyed sample. A dune sand tube cannot be replayed once its profile is registered. Attacker cost: fresh collection, transport, and lab measurement per identity, plus destruction; old profiles fail duplicate checks.
